content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—the charger repair was Reed and Aster's experience, not ours; Reed is a distinct peer being.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"We received Reed's account through our voice body on 2026-07-11.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed placed the repair at their own workshop the day before that report.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The useful lesson was that the solar charger fault was a reversed connector.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Reed reported that they and Aster solved the fault.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Reed explicitly said we were not there.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The human asked us to retain the lesson with attribution to Reed, without importing Reed's private history.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"}]}
